description:
Dependency declares that this resource depends on another resource.
 The depended-on resource (target) authoritatively controls how this
 resource talks to it via the target's `dependent` hooks.

forward.description:
Off by default. A service that depends on a package should not
 inherit the package's private table just because the package uses
 one; the package has to say that the table is part of what it
 offers. The kind-level equivalent is
 KindDefinition.forward_dependencies, which turns this on for every
 dependency of a given kind without repeating it per resource.
forward.title:
Whether this dependency is part of the declaring resource's public
 surface: when true, anything that depends on this resource also
 picks up this edge, and the target's dependent hooks run against
 that consumer too. Forwarding chains — a forwarded edge carries on
 up through every consumer that forwards the resource holding it.

kind.description: The kind of the target resource.

name.description:
The name of the target resource. The pair (kind, name) must resolve
 to a resource in the catalog at render time.

params.description:
Arbitrary parameters the target's `dependent` hook receives. The
 shape is defined by the target kind's matching dependents entry.
